boundary: M0-04 canonical TOML configuration parser before typed candidate construction
assets: bounded process memory before configuration validation
Configuration Contract integrity and source provenance
secret-bearing protected-file references and redacted diagnostics
actors: local operator supplying a configuration document
untrusted configuration bytes reaching startup validation

abuse_cases.case: oversized document, key, or scalar attempts parser allocation amplification
excessive table or entry fanout attempts aggregate allocation amplification
arrays, inline tables, nested tables, or malformed strings escape the canonical subset
abuse_cases.failure: Malformed before publication; standard TOML parser remains final syntax authority

abuse_cases.case: comment or quoted-string delimiters confuse the preflight scanner
abuse_cases.failure: bounded scanner tracks comments, quotes, and escapes; ambiguity fails Malformed

mitigations: document bytes are bounded before input ownership
a non-allocating line scanner bounds shape and tokens before toml::Table allocation
the maintained TOML parser owns full syntax and duplicate-key rejection
only known typed settings reach candidate construction
errors expose stable ResourceLimit or Malformed codes without source bytes
failure_behavior: No candidate is published, no runtime or provider is invoked, and rejected bytes are not rendered.
